work.description: The act instructs bishops and censors on the prior censorship of books in the Papal States. Issuer evidence: the volume title PII IX PONTIFICIS MAXIMI ACTA (LF33-37) as pontificate-section heading. Dating LF3703-3704 reads: Datum Romae apud S. Mariam Majorem die II Junii Anno MDCCCXLVIII. Pontificatus Nostri annoSecundo. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
